# WATAM DeFi Intelligence

> On-chain DEX analytics for protocol and token teams, exchange listing and risk teams and funds. Swaps are decoded
> directly from the chain on Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Base, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain, Monad, Solana
> and TON. Every anomaly finding carries an Evidence Card that answers five questions: what was observed; where the
> evidence is (network, blocks, pools, transactions); how it was computed (method, frozen baseline); how much it can be
> trusted (coverage, gaps, checks, caveats); and how to check it independently (detection SQL with its hash and an
> eth_getLogs recipe for any public node). Independent analytics by WATAM Intelligence (We Are The Art Makers); not
> affiliated with the projects or exchanges listed. USD values are not part of the evidence.

Evidence Cards cover anomaly findings on the EVM networks. Solana and TON entries have coverage and verified swaps, but
no anomaly findings yet. Findings describe the verified pools that were measured, never a token's whole market, and none
is an accusation.

- [Overview](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/): what a finding contains, the nine networks, how the pipeline works
- [Token catalog](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/tokens/): every tracked token with status, coverage window, verified swaps, pools and anomaly findings
- [Pricing](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/pricing/): Evidence Snapshot $900 (7 days, one token, credited to a pilot); pilots; subscriptions from $1,500/month; stablecoin or bank transfer
